comments.author: Lancelot
comments.body:
I was talking to a pirate about the blue flags and I said I would stop wearing one if we went back to the old ship ways. When it took skill to catch a Clipper and the same skill to out-maneuver a smart pirate. He agreed. Oh, the good ole dayz...

SSMFCAV- Super Speedy Modified First Class Ambush Vaiss
